---

Give your agent government procurement data: tenders and contract awards from official sources in 70+ countries, in one schema. Every tender links to the official notice. The skills follow the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format.

## What is in this repo

| Part | File | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| 20 skills | `skills/*/SKILL.md` | Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenClaw, Hermes and other agents that read SKILL.md |
| Remote MCP server | `.mcp.json`, `mcp.json`, `gemini-extension.json` | The same agents, plus Claude.ai and ChatGPT |
| Plugin manifests | `.claude-plugin/`, `plugin.json` | Claude Code plugin and marketplace, the Agent Plugins format (ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) |

## Skills

| Skill | Use it to |
|---|---|
| `find-open-tenders` | Find tenders that accept bids, by keyword and country, with deadline and official link |
| `research-public-buyer` | Profile a ministry, council, hospital or university: spend, sectors, top suppliers, open tenders |
| `competitor-government-wins` | See the public contracts a company won, or which companies win contracts for a subject |
| `tender-alerts` | Save a search and get new matches by email, webhook, Google Sheets or a polling job |
| `sell-to-state-api` | Reference for the REST API and the MCP tools: auth, filters, errors, limits |

### Feature skills

One skill per feature of Sell to State: one task, with the MCP tools and REST calls for it. All features: [selltostate.com/features](https://www.selltostate.com/features/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=sts-public-repos&utm_content=selltostate-skills).

| Skill | Task |
|---|---|
| `selltostate-agency-tech-stack` | Agency technology profile (in development: fallback steps) |
| `selltostate-ai-agent-tender-search` | AI agents: Claude, ChatGPT and MCP |
| `selltostate-competitor-tracking` | Competitor contract wins |
| `selltostate-contract-award-data` | Contract awards: who won, at what price |
| `selltostate-contract-renewal-forecast` | Contract renewal forecast (in development: fallback steps) |
| `selltostate-document-tender-matching` | Tender matches from your documents (in development: fallback steps) |
| `selltostate-export-tenders-csv` | CSV export |
| `selltostate-government-contracts-database` | Buyers, suppliers and awards database |
| `selltostate-saved-search-alerts` | Saved searches and email alerts |
| `selltostate-search-government-contracts` | Search tenders in 70+ countries |
| `selltostate-tender-automation` | Automation with n8n and Activepieces |
| `selltostate-tender-data-api` | REST API |
| `selltostate-tender-eligibility-check` | Eligibility check for each tender (in development: fallback steps) |
| `selltostate-tenders-in-english` | Search in English, match local languages |
| `selltostate-website-to-tenders` | Tender matches from your website |

## Install

You need a Sell to State account with an active plan. [Start here](https://app.selltostate.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=sts-public-repos&utm_content=selltostate-skills).

### Claude Code (skills and MCP)

```
/plugin marketplace add getbeton/selltostate-skills
/plugin install sell-to-state@sell-to-state
```

### Any agent that reads skills ([skills.sh](https://skills.sh))

```bash
npx skills add getbeton/selltostate-skills
```

### Gemini CLI (skills and MCP)

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/getbeton/selltostate-skills
```

### Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client

Add a remote MCP server with this URL. The client signs you in with OAuth.

```
https://app.selltostate.com/api/mcp
```

### Without MCP

The skills call the REST API with a key. Create one at [app.selltostate.com/account/keys](https://app.selltostate.com/account/keys?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=sts-public-repos&utm_content=selltostate-skills) and set it in your shell:

```bash
export STS_API_KEY=sts_...
```
